correctness.rationale: The literal factor trichotomy separates constant factors, factors containing unique middle 10, and first/last 01 mixed factors. Because middle 10 forces B_last or C_first and letters 0,1 force one of each symbol, every size-two attractor falls into the four cases, classified using maximal constant runs and mixed-boundary occurrences; reverse-complement gives the remaining two families. The existence of three-position witnesses and exact overlap at the central pair yields the sharp complete unbounded phase diagram and count. Independent literal-occurrence search over all 256 tuples 1<=a,b,c,d<=4 reproduced every possible optimal pair and phase outcome, but finite search is not used for the infinite theorem.
